card.name: Sulfite allergic-reaction warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside the stock sulfite warning, mainly 'yl' in anaphylactic and 'less' in 'life-threatening or less severe'. Also seen on a few linking words in suicidal-thoughts warnings.

modes.label: Sulfite warning text
modes.description: Fires partway through the sodium metabisulfite allergic-type reaction sentence, on 'yl' or 'less'.
modes.example: a sulfite that may cause allergic-type reactions including anaph<<yl>>actic symptoms and life-threatening or less severe

modes.label: Suicidality warning links
modes.description: Fires on a small linking word in advice about watching for mood or suicidal-thought changes.
modes.example: should be advised<< of>> the need to be alert for the emergence

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about something occurring or causing an event, such as 'causing' and 'cases'.
